learn.canDo: Control chat cost: full history with prompt caching, streaming, token budgets and routing for chatty turns.
learn.why: Chat is where per-turn input growth bites. Interviewers want caching, history policy and abuse control.

learn.canDo: Design retrieval for confidential multi-tenant documents: hybrid search, reranking, isolation in the index and quantized vectors.
learn.why: Legal RAG makes tenant isolation as important as recall. Isolation belongs in the structure, not a filter.
learn.keyIdea: Put the boundary in the index.

learn.canDo: Design a coding agent that finishes tasks, costs little and cannot do much damage: a test loop, a microVM and an allowlist.
learn.why: Capability and safety are one design. The environment, not the prompt, bounds the damage.

learn.canDo: Design the gateway every AI feature uses: cascade routing, a verified cache, failover, safe retries, budgets and async logs.
learn.why: A gateway has to be cheaper than what it saves and must not become the next outage.
learn.keyIdea: The door must not become the outage.

learn.canDo: Choose an escalation threshold with retrieval, a policy check and sampled review, trading wrong answers against human hours.
learn.why: Human escalation is a threshold, and every point moves work between customers and people.
learn.keyIdea: The threshold trades customers against queues.

learn.canDo: Design an extraction pipeline with a queue, schema-constrained output, validation and a dead-letter queue.
learn.why: Document pipelines fail by surge, by poison documents and by quiet inaccuracy. Each has its own control.
learn.keyIdea: Give every failure somewhere to go.

chapter.story: Pigeon's AI features are in production, and the team rehearses the design questions an interviewer would ask about them.
outcomes: Design a chat service, a gateway and a coding agent with their costs
Keep confidential documents apart in a shared search
Choose an escalation threshold with data
Build a document pipeline that survives a surge
chapter.why: The AI interview cases combine every earlier chapter into a design with a bill, an error rate and a risk. Each lab shows the trade-off with numbers.
chapter.payoff: In an interview you can design an AI system and defend its cost and failure modes. At work you will review one with the same questions.
